note: The native overlay applied by apply-native-patches.mjs in FULL mode (QR_NATIVE_MODULES=all, the default; none = no Kotlin at all). Edit versions here, not in the script.

gradle.note: Kotlin 2.2.20 is the version Capacitor 8 itself recommends (AGP 8.13 / Gradle 8.14 / JDK 21). Room MUST be 2.7.0 or newer when Kotlin is 2.1 or newer: Room 2.6.1 stops with 'Provided Metadata instance has version 2.1.0, while maximum supported version is 2.0.0' - that was the reason why the full build failed and only the SAFE-MODE APK (no widgets, no exact alarms, no notification plugins) was produced. Room is processed with kapt, so no KSP version has to match the Kotlin version.

tokens.__APP_ID__: the application id / namespace of the generated project
